description: This Java class defines the command 'RetrieveStatistics' used in a devops context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and managing command headers, specifically for retrieving statistics about stored Things.

classes.name: RetrieveStatistics
classes.description: Main class representing the command to retrieve stored statistics about Things in the system, immutable, with JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveStatistics with specified headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveStatistics from a JSON string or JSON object, with specified headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds command-specific data to the JSON payload, inherited from superclass.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, in this case, QUERY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of RetrieveStatistics with the specified headers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command object.
